decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.

Reason: In order to comply with Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990, as amended by Section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: 1665-P-005 Rev A, 1665-P-006 Rev A and 1665-P-007 Rev A. Received: 31.08.2026. 1665-P-004 Rev B. Received: 24.09.2026
Reason: In order to ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission.

Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building, unless otherwise shown on the approved plans.
Reason: In order to safeguard the appearance of the area.

Condition : 4 - The windows formed in the side dormer shall be obscure-glazed and non-opening below 1.7 metres above internal floor level. The windows shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than in accordance with the requirements of this condition. 
Reason: In order to protect neighbours' privacy

Condition : 5 - The detached single storey outbuilding hereby permitted shall only be used for a purpose incidental to the enjoyment of the house at the 'Site Address' described at the top of this decision letter and for no other purpose (for example, it may not be used as a self-contained dwelling or contain a bedroom, bathroom, kitchen or other primary residential accommodation, nor may it be used for business purposes). 
Reason: In order to protect neighbours' living conditions and the character of the area.

Condition : 6 - The window to be fitted on the front roof face of the dwelling shall be black-framed and traditional, conservation-style.
Reason: In order to safeguard the architectural and historic interest of the [conservation area/listed building].
description: Erection of a rear and side roof extension with one front roof window to the house.  Erection of a single storey outbuilding to the rear garden.
